item.description:
• HTML pages are references that run live, filling the viewer
  • A saved link opens as the live website
  • The m42 command and a skill for AI agents, with m42 current to say what is open
  • Sites that animate themselves in no longer get a black picture, and Retake Picture takes it again
  • Press Command while scrubbing a video to start a range
  • Videos open with sound on, M mutes, and the choice is remembered
